title: Grateful Dead Live at Providence Civic Center on 1980-09-04
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > CD-Wave > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 1644 Tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 12/2009
source: FOB AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300/CP1 cardioids > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLII 90's, mics on stand, set up FOB aprx 20th row, center right. Taped by Tim Friend.

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures a top‑rate Providence show with crystal‑clear sound.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the phenomenal audio quality, calling it a must‑have and noting that it delivers the full concert experience even on headphones. The performance itself is described as “top rate” and “fantastic,” making this release highly recommended for any Deadhead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews consistently praise both the show and the audio, indicating an outstanding performance with excellent audience recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Praised as crystal‑clear, immersive, and comparable to a matrix; no noted flaws or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans describe the set as fantastic and top‑rate, flowing smoothly with high energy throughout.
